eps.d: Chris Evans follows up his one-off edition aired in June, with the first of a brand new series of the lively entertainment show mixing music and chat with stunts and skits, featuring U2, Take That, Steve Coogan, Slaves and Saoirse Ronan in its opening line-up.

eps.t: Justin Bieber, Dawn French, Macklemore & Ryan Lewis, Nicholas Hoult, Hurts
eps.d: Chris Evans hosts the lively entertainment show. The week's guests include singer Justin Bieber, actress Dawn French, hip hop stars Macklemore & Ryan Lewis, X-Men: Apocalypse actor Nicholas Hoult and synthpop duo Hurts.

eps.t: Duran Duran, Cheryl Fernandez-Versini, Eagles of Death Metal, Foals
eps.d: Chris Evans welcomes guests including Duran Duran and former Girls Aloud member, now X Factor judge Cheryl Fernandez-Versini to his lively entertainment show. Plus, music by Eagles of Death Metal and Foals.

eps.t: Coldplay, Julianne Moore, Stanley Tucci, the Maccebees, the Vamps
eps.d: Coldplay and American actors Julianne Moore and Stanley Tucci join host Chris Evans for some lively banter, together with stunts and skits direct from the programme's new home in central London. Plus, music by the Maccabees and the Vamps.

eps.t: Mark Ronson, ELO, Hozier, Stereophonics
eps.d: Chris Evans' seminal cult entertainment show continues the new series with brand new features, stunts and skits and guests including musician, DJ, singer and record producer Mark Ronson. Plus, music by ELO, Hozier and Stereophonics.

eps.t: Ellie Goulding, the Vamps, Wolf Alice, Jamie Lawson
eps.d: Chris Evans continues the revamped series, broadcasting from a new home in central London, with features and raucous stunts, and guests including Ellie Goulding, the Vamps, Wolf Alice and Jamie Lawson.

eps.t: Kylie Minogue, Daniel Radcliffe, Florence and the Machine, Mumford & Sons, Nathaniel Rateliff & the Night Sweats
eps.d: Chris Evans continues the revamped series, broadcasting from a new home in central London. Guests include Kylie Minogue and Daniel Radcliffe, while music is provided courtesy of Florence and the Machine, Mumford & Sons, and Nathaniel Rateliff & the Night Sweats.

eps.t: Martin Freeman, Idris Elba, Paul Heaton and Jacqui Abbott, Rita Ora, Sigma
eps.d: Actors Martin Freeman and Idris Elba, musical duo Paul Heaton and Jacqui Abbott, singer-songwriter James Bay, singer and X Factor judge Rita Ora and drum 'n' bass duo Sigma join Chris Evans for the lively entertainment show mixing music and chat with stunts and skits.

eps.t: Christmas Special
eps.d: Christmas special co-hosted by Alan Partridge, with guests James Corden, Jack Whitehall, Lee Mack, Tom Jones, Bryan Adams, Lianne La Havas and Elle King.

eps.t: New Year Special
eps.d: With guests Quentin Tarantino, Kurt Russell, Will Poulter, Sia, New Order, Olly Murs, The Vaccines, Izzy Bizu and Alex Jones.
